title: Airplane crash altiport de Megève france altiport france landing without landing gear (HD)
summary: Cockpit footage of an approach to the Megeve altiport in France that ends in a gear-up landing, with the warning horn audible throughout. Everyone aboard survived and the crew had thousands of flight hours.
why: Cited as a vivid example that experienced pilots can ignore loud alarms, in threads on alarm design and gear-up landings.

quote.text: two experienced pilots land gear up (in a small single engine machine) even though it beeps loudly
